title: Forge Craft progress plan
completion_rule: A workflow is verified only within its documented bounds. Product parity requires a release/platform-specific inventory and originating-application acceptance evidence.

milestones.title: Native editing foundation
milestones.acceptance: Author, undo, save/reopen and export supported content without silent loss.

milestones.title: Semantic engineering workbenches
milestones.acceptance: Retain domain parameters and references; independently check geometry, quantities, interpolation and toolpaths.

milestones.title: Advanced authoring and maintained documentation
milestones.acceptance: Pass closed-mesh volume/winding, analytic arc stationing, interpolation/modifier, migration, CLI and reversible desktop cases; publish generated wiki, full feature inventory and progress records. Record raw code-audit findings and remediate new production failure paths without hiding legacy debt.

milestones.title: Constraint-driven CAD and solid modeling
milestones.acceptance: Implement persistent sketch constraints with convergence/conflict diagnostics, feature dependencies, robust solid operations and assembly/drawing workflows.

milestones.title: Building and infrastructure systems
milestones.acceptance: Add families/spaces, specialist systems, coordination, engineering analysis, corridors, grading, networks, assets and geospatial validation.

milestones.title: Production manufacturing
milestones.acceptance: Validate machine posts, tools, ramp/adaptive/multi-axis paths, stock/fixture collision models, additive/nesting and manufacturing analysis.

milestones.title: Media production
milestones.acceptance: Implement rigs, skinning, constraints, shaders, cameras, lighting, production rendering, dynamics and compositing with independent fixtures.

milestones.title: Connected project services
milestones.acceptance: Implement account/project permissions, multi-user revisions/sync and independently exercised service workflows.

milestones.title: Interchange and packaged releases
milestones.acceptance: Expand neutral and native interchange; verify metadata/references/editability and clean Windows/macOS/Linux installs and recovery.

milestones.title: Full product acceptance
milestones.acceptance: Choose each product release and platform; obtain authoritative fixtures and originating applications, inventory every required workflow and record independent acceptance results.
